ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: A yearly financial record of everything that comes in and everything that goes out.
ledger.loadError: Your ledgers could not be loaded.

empty.title: Set your finish line
empty.description: Choose a starting balance and a period. Most people pick 12 months.
empty.onlyOwner: Only the profile owner can create ledgers.
empty.lockedTitle: Your ledger opens after your envelopes
empty.lockedDescription: Name 1 revenue and 3 expense envelopes first. Then set your finish line.
empty.firstTransaction: Day 1 starts with your first transaction. Add one for each envelope.

ledger.closedNotice: This ledger is closed and read-only. Reopen it from the actions menu to record transactions.

envelopesNotice.required: Envelopes are required to record transactions.

ledger.permissionNotice: You don't have permission to record transactions in this ledger.

newTransaction.title: New transaction
newTransaction.description: Pick a day on the calendar, select an envelope and enter the amount.

delete.title: Delete this ledger?
delete.description: This permanently removes the ledger and ALL of its transactions. This cannot be undone.

deleteTransaction.title: Delete this transaction?
deleteTransaction.description: The transaction will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

form.eventDateHint: Pick the day on the calendar.
form.hint: Choose an envelope and enter a whole amount of 1 or more to add the transaction.

createDialog.title: Create a new ledger
createDialog.description: A ledger keeps a yearly financial record of your transactions.
createDialog.nextDescription: The start date follows this ledger, and the suggested end date keeps the same calendar-month span. You can change the end date.
createDialog.startsOnFirstDay: The ledger starts on the first day of this month.
createDialog.startLocked: This date is fixed to the day after the previous ledger ends.
createDialog.endsOnLastDay: The ledger ends on the last day of this month.
